17.why: CatroModulo_CM-3.cpp:147 reads this jack with getVoltage, channel 0 only, and ORs it with the STEP button through C++ ||, so any voltage other than exactly 0V, negative included, becomes 1.0 and 0V becomes 0.0. That 1.0 or 0.0 goes to CM_SelSeq::step at CatroModulo.hpp:62, whose dsp::SchmittTrigger fires when the value reaches 1 and rearms when it drops to 0, advancing the sequence one place. Line 143 tests the bpm jack first: with a cable in bpm, lines 144 and 145 step the sequence from the internal clock and this jack is never read.

comment: Read at commit d55cb70. The enum carries a PARAM_Q that is never given a configParam and whose createParam call is commented out at line 316, so it has no widget, no tooltip and no position, and it is left untagged. The sequencer steps from the internal clock whenever the bpm jack is patched, and the step jack and step button are then ignored. Patterns 2 and 3 of the sixteen hold -1 in every other slot, which mutes all eight outputs for that step. The maker's manual gives the bpm standard as 1V per 50 bpm; the code's CM_BpmClock::cvtobpm multiplies by 60. Nothing here is polyphonic.
